label: Israel: 9 regions to 4
why: A player (feedback 1795622961-6b650222) finds 9 regions too many for Israel. The default floor (0.5M) on CBS subdistricts left nearly every subdistrict its own zone. Four, along where commutes go (the joint solve's flows): Tel Aviv takes HaSharon (Netanya, Kfar Sava), Ramla (Lod, Modi'in) and Ashqelon (Ashdod, Ashkelon, Kiryat Gat), CBS's Tel Aviv metropolitan area and its southern outer ring; Haifa takes Akko, Zefat, Yizre'el and Kinneret (the north); Be'er Sheva and Jerusalem as they are. Tel Aviv's FUAs for pop_vs_fua add Netanya, Ashdod and Ashkelon (GHS-FUA 705, 262, 84).
